summary: Encode a NativeImage as PNG bytes.

target.notes: Requires an image codec/native image wrapper, not Chromium.

semantics.binary_exactness: valid PNG; byte sequence may depend on encoder

caveats: Do not compare encoded PNG bytes for semantic equality unless encoder determinism is part of the compatibility contract; decoded pixels are the stronger behavioral oracle.

tests.name: encode png
tests.expected_behavior: returns a Buffer-compatible PNG byte sequence

tests.name: empty image
tests.expected_behavior: must follow Electron empty-image encoding behavior rather than crashing the native codec
